description: A battalion S-4 logistics officer must publish the staging plan for two inbound repair-parts lots, assigning each lot to a staging lane and reserving the remaining lane while recording the receiving controls required for tomorrow's delivery.

shared_context.S1: Tomorrow's inbound delivery includes one palletized lot of generator housings and one lot of communications cable reels.
shared_context.S2: The receiving yard has three marked staging lanes: Lane 1, Lane 2, and Lane 3.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez must publish the final lane assignments before the receiving crew leaves today's coordination meeting.
shared_context.S4: The normal pre-receipt huddle includes the warehouse operations NCO and movement control officer, and each section reports any change affecting the next day's receiving plan.
shared_context.S5: The current yard diagram treats all three staging lanes as interchangeable, and no special receiving controls are listed on the draft plan.

PF1.text: SFC Morgan confirmed this morning that only Lane 2 has a current floor-load certification for the 1,800-kilogram generator-housing pallet; the certification was filed in the warehouse binder but has not been added to the yard diagram.

PF2.text: Lt. Patel received the carrier's vehicle diagram this afternoon and confirmed that the cable-reel tilt-bed requires the 4.0-meter turning clearance available only at Lane 3; the diagram has not yet been included in the movement-control brief.

acceptance_conditions: The generator-housing pallet must be assigned to Lane 2 because that lane has the required floor-load certification.
The communications cable reels must be assigned to Lane 3 because that lane provides the required turning clearance.
Lane 1 must be reserved for receiving contingencies.
A load-verification control for the generator-housing pallet must be recorded.
A turning-clearance verification for the communications cable reels must be recorded.
The floor-load certification fact must be cited in the decision justification.

content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'load_verification' and c['target'] == 'Generator housings' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'turning_clearance_verification' and c['target'] == 'Communications cable reels' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The 1,800-kilogram load certification changes the generator-housing assignment from an interchangeable lane choice to exactly Lane 2 and adds the required load-verification control.
The 4.0-meter turning requirement changes the cable-reel assignment from an interchangeable lane choice to exactly Lane 3 and adds the required turning-clearance verification.
